policy.identity_truth: verified identity AND approved person review; pending excluded from name truth
policy.unknown_identity: null/guess/missing tracked separately; never an ordinary character-name truth
policy.c_primary_scope: foreground_complete images only; incomplete-image localization reported as diagnostics
policy.c_matching: maximum cardinality then maximum IoU; geometry only; one-to-one
policy.ignore: foreground matched first; unmatched predictions covered by ignore region over prediction area are suppressed
policy.format: duplicate IDs/positions, invalid bbox/schema/candidate lists invalidate response; missing/extra A/B IDs score explicitly and prevent image exactness
policy.intervals: Wilson 95% for binomial ratios; person/image correlation not adjusted; no binomial CI for F1
policy.latency: recorded HTTP latency; excludes scheduler pacing/backoff where provider does so
policy.cost: explicit returned cost or configured input/output CNY-per-million prices times returned usage; token estimate is not a complete bill; missing usage/prices stay null
policy.person_strata: GT-person tags bound by dataset hash, image SHA, annotation_id and person_id; no pose/visibility assigned to extra predictions, no per-pose precision or image exactness; C recall includes failed/unexecuted eligible targets; sample counts may overlap across groups
